stem.text: A skydiver is falling at constant velocity. She then opens her parachute. The graph shows the variation with time of her velocity.

stem.alt: Velocity–time graph with axes labelled velocity and time. Points on the time axis are labelled 0, t1, t2 and t3.

stem.text: Which statements about the motion of the skydiver are correct?

items: The magnitude of the acceleration is maximum at time $t_{2}$.
The magnitude of the drag force at time $t_{1}$ equals the magnitude of the drag force at time $t_{3}$.
The magnitude of the drag force is maximum at time $t_{1}$.
